withdrawalsWithoutFee.other: {count} withdrawals without a fee count as fee 0.

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.intro: Money you put into the stores, in the store currency (for now, only US dollar stores). The amount paid in R$ is for reference only.

fullScanConfirm.title: Full scan
fullScanConfirm.body: The app will read the whole CSFloat trade and statement history again, without stopping where the last import stopped. This uses more requests and can take up to 2 minutes. Nothing is duplicated: trades already imported are recognized by their ID, and your hand-made entries keep being linked by float (or by item, price and day). Trades before the cutoff date ({date}) stay out, so money already in your entries and deposits is not counted twice. To import older trades, change the cutoff date on the Imports page.
fullScanConfirm.componentsNote: The scan also fills in, once, the stickers and keychain of purchases already imported, without touching the ones you registered by hand.

cutoffChange.title: Change cutoff date
cutoffChange.blockBody: Up to this date, you have already entered everything by hand or that period's balance is in a deposit. Trades before it are not imported.
cutoffChange.backwardHelp: Earlier date: imports the trades between the new date and the current one. New purchases deduct from the CSFloat store balance, and new sales credit it. If one of your deposits already included that period, money will be counted twice.
cutoffChange.forwardHelp: Later date: nothing already imported is deleted. Trades not imported yet before the new date stop being imported, and their pending items are closed.
cutoffChange.undoHelp: The change runs a full scan and can be undone with "Undo import" while it is the latest import that changed something.
cutoffChange.upToPurchases: Up to {count} purchase(s) already seen may come in ({value}). Some may be linked to your entries.
cutoffChange.upToSales: Up to {count} sale(s) already seen may come in ({value}).
cutoffChange.mayHaveUnseen: There are trades in this period the app has never read: the full scan will bring them too.

csfloatSetup.modalBody: Instead of typing, you can import your purchases, sales, deposits and withdrawals straight from CSFloat.
csfloatSetup.modalHint: To do that, connect CSFloat in Settings: the step-by-step guide is there and takes a minute.
csfloatSetup.title: How to connect CSFloat
csfloatSetup.step1: Sign in to CSFloat with your Steam account.
csfloatSetup.step2: Open your profile and go to the "Developers" tab.
csfloatSetup.step3: Click "New Key" and copy the key.
csfloatSetup.step4: Paste the key below, click "Save key" and then "Test connection".
csfloatSetup.step5: Click "Import now" (below) or "Import from CSFloat" in the Inventory and choose the cutoff date: up to when you already entered everything by hand.
csfloatSetup.safety: The key gives access to your CSFloat account: do not share it with anyone. If it leaks, delete it on CSFloat and create another one.

openForm.title: Open {name}
openForm.introCase: The case and the chosen key leave the stock and the cost of both moves to the item you get. Real profit, balances and the stock total do not change.
openForm.introNoKey: The item leaves the stock and its cost moves to the item you get. Real profit, balances and the stock total do not change.
openForm.introTerminal: The terminal offers an item for a price. If you buy it, the price comes out of your Steam store balance. If you decline, the terminal disappears and its cost becomes a loss.
openForm.noKey: There is no compatible key in stock. Register {keyName} first.
